note: One entry per engine SHAPE. With no mini batch the whole request is the call, so a shape is a ROW COUNT and one cache directory serves every session count at that row count -- a session count loads more copies of the same engine, it does not change the engine. Primed on the SAME WIRE the cells use, so no cell can pay for a TensorRT build inside its warm-up. build_seconds is a 20 s trickle against a cold cache, so it carries the TensorRT engine build; cached_seconds is the same trickle against a FRESH server that loaded the cache. The gap is the cost every cell would otherwise have paid inside its warm-up.
